newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 5.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- U.S. President Bill Clinton confirmed that NATO enlargement should begin by 1999.
- The opposition party KDNP will initiate legal action against the government because the January 1 energy price hikes were discriminative for Hungarian-owned energy companies, KDNP said.
- The flu epidemic, which killed 19 and made some 84,000 ill, spreads at a slower pace.
- A man, in whose flat a gas explosion happened on Monday, is wanted by the police for questioning.
- Ten international trains, passing through Hungary, still goes on changed routes due to the continued strike of Czech railway workers.
